simple.summary: בַּעַל גָּד (Baʻal Gâd) means Baal-Gad , a place in Syria First listed occurrence: Josh 11 17.

definitions.full: H1171. Baal Gad גַּד בַּ֫עַל proper name, of a location Josh 11:17 ; 12:7 ; 13:5 (D), where Baal was worshipped as Gad, god of fortune, a city in the בִּקְעָה of Lebanon, under Mt. Hermon; either modern Bâniâs , Greek Paneas, NT Caesarea Philippi, where a grotto of Pan took the place of the ancient worship of Gad, Rob BR iii. 410 Tristr Tpg 271 ; or „âsbêyâ Bd Pal 297 Di; possibly = חרמון בעל compare Thes Rob BR iii. 409 .
